moreSharedAppearancesEnabled.description: Refine search to apply changes to devices that contain the warning "More shared/virtual line appearances than shared/virtual lines requested".

fewSharedAppearancesEnabled.description: Refine search to apply changes to devices that contain the warning "More shared/virtual lines requested than shared/virtual line appearances".

moreMonitorAppearancesEnabled.description: Refine search to apply changes to devices that contain the warning "More monitored line appearances than monitored lines in the user's monitoring list".

moreCPEAppearancesEnabled.description: Refine search to apply changes to devices that contain the warning "More call park extension line appearances than call park extensions in user's monitoring list".

moreModeManagementAppearancesEnabled.description: Refine search to apply changes to devices that contain the warning "More mode management lines configured for the device". The default value is false.
